content: We need to test the deployment pipeline real quick.
Sure, what do you need me to do?

First, write "deployment_v2_test" to /tmp/deploy-marker.txt

Then write "2024-01-15T10:30:00Z" to /tmp/deploy-time.txt

After that, read back /tmp/deploy-marker.txt so I can confirm the write worked. The CI system checks that file to know which version is live.
